sentences.text:
Order 
This is the first bail application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita , 2023/ 439 of Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail relating to FIR/Crime No.226/2025 registered at Police Station - Gopalganj, District - Sagar (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 376 and 306 of the IPC.

The applicant is in custody since 15.12.2025.
2.

Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that basically the deceased committed suicide in the year 2023 and merg was registered and after that in the year 2025, the offence has been registered against this applicant on the basis that, the DNA of this applicant was found in the under garments of the victim and the call record.
Trial will take time to be concluded, hence, the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.

3. Learned counsel for the State has submitted that by the statement of NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2026:MPHC-JBP:9047 2 MCRC-505-2026 witnesses, it has been brought on record that the applicant had visited the victim's house and the DNA of the applicant was found in the under garments of the victim, therefore, it is clear that the applicant had sexually assaulted the victim and as a result, the victim committed suicide, therefore, no case of bail is made out, hence, the applicant is not entitled to be released on bail.
4. Heard the parties and perused the case diary.

sentences.text: Basically, when the deceased committed suicide on 09.10.2023, no injury was found on the body of the deceased and the family members of the victim has stated that the victim was suffering from stomach pain and due to that the victim would have committed suicide.

Police searched the call record of the deceased and found that this applicant was frequently talking to the deceased and on that basis, the blood sample of the applicant and the blood sample, cloth and vaginal slide of the deceased were sent for examination and when the DNA of the applicant was found in the under garment of the deceased, it came to know that the applicant has violated her privacy and as a result,
some dispute took place between them, so the victim committed suicide.

Looking to this factual aspects only on the basis that the applicant had visited or called the victim frequently and DNA was found, no inference can be drawn that the applicant was responsible for the suicide

, coupled with the fact that trial will take time to be concluded, this Court deems it appropriate to enlarge the applicant on bail, therefore, without commenting anything on the merits of the case, this bail application is allowed.
6.

It is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on his NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2026:MPHC-JBP:9047 3 MCRC-505-2026 furnishing personal bond in a sum of Rs.50,000/-
(Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for his appearance before the said Court on all such dates as may be fixed by that Court in this regard during the pendency of trial.
7. It is further directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 480(3) of BNSS.
8. Accordingly, Misc. Criminal Case stands disposed of.

(DEVNARAYAN MISHRA) JUDGE DPS Chatur Singh Yadav @ Rahul Yadav vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 2 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/193470666/
